description: Managers: gomod (go.mod/go.sum), bazel-module (MODULE.bazel bazel_dep + oci.pull tag/digest; needs `bazelModDeps` in the server-side allowedUnsafeExecutions so it can refresh MODULE.bazel.lock), github-actions (SHA-pinned), nix (flake.lock). allowedUnsafeExecutions/binarySource are server-side options (Renovate CE helmrelease in iac), not settable here.

packageRules.description: Enable updates for indirect (transitive) Go deps. Renovate disables these by default (the gomod parser sets enabled=false on any `// indirect` line), and osvVulnerabilityAlerts only covers DIRECT deps - so transitive CVEs (e.g. golang.org/x/net GHSA) would never be fixed. Importing sigs.k8s.io/external-dns drags in a large indirect block (k8s client-go, cloud SDKs), which is exactly where those land; the churn folds into the auto-merging group:allNonMajor bulk PR.

...but never MAJOR bumps of indirect deps. A transitive module's major is chosen by whoever imports it (e.g. client-go picks structured-merge-diff/v6); bumping the `// indirect` line to /v7 adds a module path nothing imports and, for path-versioned majors, drops the one that is (see rules_tf2 go-textseg PR #101). Majors arrive when the direct importer moves.
Digest/pin updates carry no semver risk (same tag, just a resolved hash), so automerge them alongside the existing :automergeMinor coverage of minor/patch.

sigs.k8s.io/external-dns defines the webhook/provider contract we implement. Never apply majors automatically, and hold minors/patches out of the bulk PR with automerge OFF: upstream minors have changed provider semantics (DomainFilter JSON, AdjustEndpoints, registry TXT format) and need a human to read the release notes.

The Infoblox Universal DDI SDK is pre-1.0 (v0.x) and its generated models/field names have shifted between minors. Isolate it in its own PR so the diff is reviewable against the provider's rdata mapping; CI (mocked client) is not enough to prove compatibility with the live Portal API.
The distroless base image is digest-pinned in MODULE.bazel (oci.pull). Keep digest bumps in the bulk PR but tag them so they are easy to spot.
